title: BIBI CHECKS
description: Bibi Checks is a Paper 1.21+ plugin that adds secure, tradable bank checks to Minecraft servers. Players can convert money from their Vault-supported economy account into physical check items and redeem them later or trade them with other players.
body:
BIBI CHECKS adds physical bank checks to Minecraft. Players can create checks from their balance and trade them with others.

### Features
- Create checks with /bibicheck create <amount>
- Redeem by right-clicking – instant deposit to your balance
- Fully customizable item name, lore, material, and glow
- Configurable min/max check amounts
- HMAC-SHA256 protected against NBT tampering
- SQLite-backed duplicate redemption protection
- Multi-language support (EN, CZ, DE, FR)

### Commands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| /bibicheck create <amount> | Create a check |
| /bibicheck balance | Check your balance |
| /bibicheck help | Show help |
| /bibicheck give <player> <amount> | Give a check (admin) |
| /bibicheck stats | View statistics (admin) |
| /bibicheck reload | Reload config (admin) |

### Requirements
- Vault + any economy plugin (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.)
- Paper / Purpur / Spigot / Bukkit 1.21+
